description: Synthetic retrieval test queries. 'expected' lists every record that describes the same underlying problem; a hit is any expected id in the top results. 'low_keyword' marks queries written to share almost no words with the matching records. 'negatives' have no true match and are used to calibrate MATCH_THRESHOLD.

cases.query: Paper web keeps breaking right after the second press and the felt looks glazed.
Slimy deposits in the white water system and holes showing up in the finished paper.
Basis weight swinging and the headbox pressure will not settle.
Tablets failing friability because the top layer peels off.
Paper tears near the squeezing rolls and the blanket underneath seems clogged up.
Pills come out soft and their tops pop off.
Microbes grew on a dish placed beside the hole where workers put their hands into the sterile enclosure.
The storage room for long-term product tests got too damp over the weekend.

negatives.query: Forklift battery charger tripped the breaker in the finished goods warehouse.
Canteen coffee machine leaking water onto the floor.
